# The SpeedGauge Component

#### Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

## The SpeedGauge Component

SpeedBlip's most visually distinctive component is the SpeedGauge - the animated circular gauge on the Dashboard that shows the current download speed.

The gauge is built with Recharts' RadialBarChart component, configured as a semicircle from 180 degrees to 0 degrees:

```react
<RadialBarChart cx="50%" cy="75%" innerRadius="70%" outerRadius="100%" startAngle={180} endAngle={0} data={[{ value: normalizedSpeed, fill: gaugeColor }]}
```

The normalizedSpeed maps the raw Mbps value to a 0-100 scale based on the user's configured maximum threshold. The gaugeColor is dynamically selected: #22C55E (green) above 80% of threshold, #F59E0B (warning amber) between 40% and 80%, and #EF4444 (danger red) below 40%.

The needle and numeric display in the center of the gauge are positioned with absolute CSS over the RadialBarChart, giving the component its dashboard instrument look.

![Labeled diagram of the SpeedGauge showing the RadialBarChart arc, the numeric speed value in the center, the unit label (Mbps), the color zones (green/amber/red), and the absolute-positioned center overlay](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)
